Quick options (all PT):
- Tue Nov 10 — 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 11 — 10:30–11:00 (preferred on our side)
- Thu Nov 12 — 08:30–09:00 (early window)

Notes/asks:
- Marissa (AE) is traveling next week; Ben (our senior SE) can own the single-attendee session if that helps with scheduling.
- If you prefer a full-attendee session, tell me two windows that work and we’ll prioritize.
- I’m attaching a short 2‑page deck to help shape the deep-dive and will send an .ics once we lock a slot.

If you’re short on time this week, reply with the slot you prefer and we’ll take care of invites and a short pre-call checklist for any network/SaaS constraints.

Thanks — talk soon,
